title: Lecco postcard - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: davedarko (Dave Darko), LECCO postcard SAO, Hackaday Europe 2026, github.com/davedarko/Simple-Add-ons-SAO
notes: Badge-powered only, like the maker's original: the board is too small for the CR2032 clip without covering the maker's handwritten message (see README).
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected.
D1 is the LED the maker meant to be bodged across his two VCC / GND pads: a reverse-mount LED behind the bare-board word ITALY.
1.3 k (shared part, was an unspecified 'R' or a solder bridge on the original) gives about 0.45 mA through a white LED from 3.3 V.
